column1: # Kiwix ZIM archives for the Offline Emergency Library.
#   group   - skip a whole group with --skip-groups / -SkipGroups
#   folder  - where the file goes, under OfflineLibrary/
#   path    - Kiwix directory + file-name prefix, under https://download.kiwix.org/zim/
#             The installer picks the NEWEST "<prefix>YYYY-MM.zim" in that directory,
#             because Kiwix deletes old builds (dated URLs stop working).
#   note    - "dupwiki" = skipped when full Wikipedia (maxi or nopic) is downloaded
# Most entries are adapted from Project NOMAD's collections/kiwix-categories.json
# (Crosstalk Solutions, Apache-2.0). Content keeps its own licence (see each archive).
